text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the north side of Montclair Avenue, between Bathurst Street and a point 24.1 metres east of Bathurst Street. This is in response to multiple instances where a parked vehicle would partially block the driveway access for residents at 194 and 196 Montclair Avenue. This proposal will improve driveway access for residents at these premises and will not result in the loss of any parking spaces on Montclair Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., daily, on the north side of Montclair Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Lonsmount Drive. 2. Authorized parking prohibition to be in effect at all times, on the north side of Montclair Avenue, between Bathurst Street and a point 24.1 metres east of Bathurst Street. 3. Authorized parking prohibition in be in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., daily, on the north side of Montclair Avenue, between a point 24.1 metres east of Bathurst Street and Lonsmount Drive.
